scope: Exact captured native photo compositions and all 69 unchanged SVGs. Sort projects its complete original buffer below the supplied y=80 horizon and retains all 25 gradient columns. Mosaic starts with all 21 supplied crops, then projects original Bayer/wave/shrink math into the full 8×6 photographic tile field. Interlace retains both original fields and every row/jitter beneath the 38 supplied scanlines. Posterize starts with three exact ring SVGs and crossfades to the complete original quantizer. Full retains every original model, typed buffer and source render; all scene photos use the approved local v2 set.
